en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing the interior hall of a grand thermal bath establishment. The view looks onto an upper-level gallery with metal railings, arched doorways and windows, and a high glass roof. Several people are seen walking or sitting in the hall. Printed captions along the bottom identify the place as a thermal establishment in Aix-les-Bains, Savoie, France, specifically the hall of the showers in the south annex.
